translations.translation: 科学文档结合连续的叙述与公式、表格、参考文献和专业术语。一个有用的阅读助手应翻译叙述内容，同时保留文档的原意和结构。研究人员常阅读同一段落多次，以理解新方法并与其他工作进行比较。本地语言模型可以支持这一过程，无需将文档发送到远程服务。其实际速度取决于内存带宽、处理器指令、工作线程以及需要处理的上下文量。短答案可能在处理器达到稳定运行状态前结束，因此重复测量并获取更长输出是有效的。提示处理和token生成应分别测量，因为它们执行不同的计算。公平比较也记录了精确的模型文件、推理设置和设备条件。本实验的目标是生成一份准确的中文翻译，并保留足够的时间信息以区分引擎性能与应用开销。
translations.source: Scientific documents combine continuous prose with equations, tables, references, and technical terminology. A useful reading assistant should translate the prose while preserving the original meaning and the structure of the document. Researchers often read the same paragraph several times to understand an unfamiliar method and compare it with earlier work. Local language models can support this process without sending the document to a remote service. Their practical speed depends on memory bandwidth, processor instructions, worker threads, and the amount of context being processed. A short answer may finish before the processor reaches a steady operating state, so repeated measurements with longer outputs are useful. Prompt processing and token generation should be measured separately because they perform different kinds of computation. A fair comparison also records the exact model file, inference settings, and device conditions. The goal of this experiment is to produce a faithful Chinese translation and retain enough timing information to distinguish engine performance from application overhead.

translations.source: Scientific documents combine continuous prose with equations, tables, references, and technical terminology. A useful reading assistant should translate the prose while preserving the original meaning and the structure of the document. Researchers often read the same paragraph several times to understand an unfamiliar method and compare it with earlier work. Local language models can support this process without sending the document to a remote service. Their practical speed depends on memory bandwidth, processor instructions, worker threads, and the amount of context being processed. A short answer may finish before the processor reaches a steady operating state, so repeated measurements with longer outputs are useful. Prompt processing and token generation should be measured separately because they perform different kinds of computation. A fair comparison also records the exact model file, inference settings, and device conditions. The goal of this experiment is to produce a faithful Chinese translation and retain enough timing information to distinguish engine performance from application overhead.

{"sentences":[{"id":"s1","text":"Scientific documents combine continuous prose with equations, tables, references, and technical terminology. A useful reading assistant should translate the prose while preserving the original meaning and the structure of the document. Researchers often read the same paragraph several times to understand an unfamiliar method and compare it with earlier work. Local language models can support this process without sending the document to a remote service. Their practical speed depends on memory bandwidth, processor instructions, worker threads, and the amount of context being processed. A short answer may finish before the processor reaches a steady operating state, so repeated measurements with longer outputs are useful. Prompt processing and token generation should be measured separately because they perform different kinds of computation. A fair comparison also records the exact model file, inference settings, and device conditions. The goal of this experiment is to produce a faithful Chinese translation and retain enough timing information to distinguish engine performance from application overhead."}]}

translations.translation: 科学文档结合连续的叙述与公式、表格、参考文献和专业术语。一个有用的阅读助手应将叙述翻译成中文，同时保留原文含义和文档结构。研究人员常阅读同一段文字多次，以理解一种新方法并与其他工作进行比较。本地语言模型可以支持这一过程，无需将文档发送到远程服务。其实际速度取决于内存带宽、处理器指令、工作线程以及需要处理的上下文量。短答案可能在处理器达到稳定运行状态之前完成，因此重复测量并获取更长输出是有效的。提示处理和令牌生成应分别测量，因为它们执行不同的计算类型。公平的比较也记录了模型文件、推理设置和设备条件。本实验的目标是生成一个忠实的中文翻译，并保留足够的时序信息以区分引擎性能与应用开销。
translations.source: Scientific documents combine continuous prose with equations, tables, references, and technical terminology. A useful reading assistant should translate the prose while preserving the original meaning and the structure of the document. Researchers often read the same paragraph several times to understand an unfamiliar method and compare it with earlier work. Local language models can support this process without sending the document to a remote service. Their practical speed depends on memory bandwidth, processor instructions, worker threads, and the amount of context being processed. A short answer may finish before the processor reaches a steady operating state, so repeated measurements with longer outputs are useful. Prompt processing and token generation should be measured separately because they perform different kinds of computation. A fair comparison also records the exact model file, inference settings, and device conditions. The goal of this experiment is to produce a faithful Chinese translation and retain enough timing information to distinguish engine performance from application overhead.
